The mixin (app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss:126) emits `-webkit-box-ordinal-group: $val`, but in the old `-webkit-box` flexbox model `-webkit-box-ordinal-group` is 1-based (default 1), whereas modern `order` is 0-based (default 0).
